Title: Home catalog lists products
Steps: 1. Navigate to home 2. Observe product cards
Expected Result: At least one product name and price is visible

Title: Search filters catalog by keyword
Expected Result: Results relate to hammer; empty state only if no match

Title: Login rejected with wrong password
Steps: 1. Enter customer email 2. Enter invalid password 3. Submit
Expected Result: Error is shown; user stays unauthenticated

Title: Login with valid demo customer
Steps: 1. Enter valid email and password 2. Submit

Title: Register unique customer then login
Steps: 1. Fill valid unique details 2. Submit 3. Login
Expected Result: Account is created and profile email matches

Title: Add two products and update quantity
Preconditions: Logged in or guest cart allowed
Steps: 1. Open product 2. Increase qty 3. Add to cart 4. Repeat second product
Expected Result: Cart shows both lines and updated quantity

Title: COD checkout requires two Confirm clicks for invoice
Preconditions: Cart has in-stock items and user is logged in
Steps: 1. Proceed checkout 2. Select cash on delivery 3. Click Confirm 4. Click Confirm again 5. Open My Invoices
Expected Result: Payment success; invoice appears under My Invoices
